$entry_count = 0
$offset = 0

while \($offset + 11 -lt $autoloadBytes.Length\) {
    $dest = $autoloadBytes[$offset] + $autoloadBytes[$offset+1]*256 + $autoloadBytes[$offset+2]*65536 + $autoloadBytes[$offset+3]*16777216
    $size = $autoloadBytes[$offset+4] + $autoloadBytes[$offset+5]*256 + $autoloadBytes[$offset+6]*65536 + $autoloadBytes[$offset+7]*16777216
    $bss_size = $autoloadBytes[$offset+8] + $autoloadBytes[$offset+9]*256 + $autoloadBytes[$offset+10]*65536 + $autoloadBytes[$offset+11]*16777216
    
    if \($dest -ne 0 -or $size -ne 0 -or $bss_size -ne 0\) {
        $entry_count++
        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "  Entry $entry_count:"
        Write-Host "    Destination: 0x$\($dest.ToString\('X8'\)\)"
        Write-Host "    Size: 0x$\($size.ToString\('X8'\)\)"
        Write-Host "    BSS Size: 0x$\($bss_size.ToString\('X8'\)\)"

            $end_addr = $dest + $size + $bss_size
            Write-Host "    End: 0x$\($end_addr.ToString\('X8'\)\)"
        }
    }

    @{ pattern = @\(0x00, 0x00, 0x10, 0x02\); name = "0x02100000"; },
    @{ pattern = @\(0x00, 0x00, 0x11, 0x02\); name = "0x02110000"; },
    @{ pattern = @\(0x00, 0x00, 0x12, 0x02\); name = "0x02120000"; },
    @{ pattern = @\(0x00, 0x00, 0x20, 0x02\); name = "0x02200000"; },
    @{ pattern = @\(0x00, 0x00, 0x30, 0x02\); name = "0x02300000"; }
\)

$found_any = $false

foreach \($pat in $patterns\) {
    $matches = @\(\)
    $patBytes = [byte[]]$pat.pattern
    
    for \($i = 0; $i -le $arm9Bytes.Length - $patBytes.Length; $i++\) {
        $match = $true
        for \($j = 0; $j -lt $patBytes.Length; $j++\) {
            if \($arm9Bytes[$i + $j] -ne $patBytes[$j]\) {
                $match = $false
                break
            }
        }
        
        if \($match\) {
            $matches += $i
        }
    }
    
    if \($matches.Count -gt 0\) {
        $found_any = $true
        Write-Host "Found $\($pat.name\): $\($matches.Count\) location\(s\)"
        foreach \($match in $matches\) {
            Write-Host "  offset 0x$\($match.ToString\('X8'\)\)"
        }
    }
}

}
